<h2 style={{ marginTop: 24, marginBottom: 24 }}>Frictionless play</h2>
<Grid container spacing={8}>
  <Grid item xs={12} md={5}>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>No complicated downloads</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Roblox is built on the cloud, allowing users to join new games in seconds, without having to download massive files.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>Automatic matchmaking</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Users are automatically placed in servers with friends and other users from their region, making it easier than ever to connect with friends and make new ones.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>Cross-platform support</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Games can be published across all major devices, allowing players to play how they want, where they want, with whomever they want.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </Grid>
  <Grid item xs={12} md={7}>
    <img
      style={{ width: '100%', height: 'auto' }}
      src="../assets/developer-jumpstart/image7.png"
      alt=""
    />
  </Grid>
</Grid>

<h2 style={{ marginTop: 48, marginBottom: 24 }}>Collaborate with your players</h2>
<Grid container spacing={8}>
  <Grid item xs={12} md={5}>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>Communities are part of the process</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Due to the user-generated content (UGC) nature of Roblox, the community is much more involved, as many devs are also often community members. Cultivating a healthy community and involving users in development is key to success.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>Benefit from direct feedback</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Since Roblox enables creators to develop and publish updates quickly, they can efficiently gather feedback and iterate -- resulting in a deeper understanding of their audience and a more focused experience for users.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </Grid>
  <Grid item xs={12} md={7}>
    <img
      style={{ width: '100%', height: 'auto' }}
      src="../assets/developer-jumpstart/image16.jpg"
      alt=""
    />
  </Grid>
</Grid>

<h2 style={{ marginTop: 48, marginBottom: 24 }}>Reach beyond Roblox</h2>
<Grid container spacing={8}>
  <Grid item xs={12} md={5}>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>Massive creator ecosystem</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Roblox fuels a thriving community of content creators on platforms like YouTube and TikTok, generating views and driving engagement.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
    <Card style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
      <CardContent>
        <h4>Engaged cross-platform audience</h4>
        <Typography variant='body1'>Roblox content resonates beyond the platform, with creators building loyal followings and extending reach to new players.</Typography>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  </Grid>
  <Grid item xs={12} md={7}>
    <img
      style={{ width: '100%', height: 'auto' }}
      src="../assets/developer-jumpstart/image42.png"
      alt=""
    />
  </Grid>
</Grid>
